_comment: Per-venue screen hardware - a candidate metadata overlay, not an oracle.
Chains advertise one brand string for hardware that differs materially:
'IMAX with Laser at AMC' covers both 1.43:1 GT houses and standard 1.90:1
houses. Independents rarely say which room a print is screening in at all.
Applies to every format, not just IMAX: a rep house's 70mm-capable screen,
a Dolby Cinema room, a nitrate-certified booth. Only a handful of venues
worldwide can project nitrate, which is exactly the kind of fact that
SEED DATA - every row currently says source:seed-unverified and has
verified_at:null. It is seven candidate rows, not a national registry.
The runtime exposes the rows for inspection but will not use them to
infer a live screening's missing presentation details until verified.
Verify each row against a named source, record the source and date, then
change source and set verified_at. An absent venue is unknown, not false.
lat/lon are approximate seed coordinates; do not treat them as authoritative.
provenance_policy: A row is eligible for inference only when source is not seed-unverified and verified_at is non-null.
